dict.string: Volna uses automation to identify the foreground app and browser and pause supported media while you dictate.
Volna uses Accessibility to paste dictation and read selected text for Voice Action.
Volna records the other participants' audio only while you record a meeting, and keeps it on this Mac.
Volna reads your calendar on this Mac to remind you before meetings and title their recordings. Nothing leaves your Mac.
